subject: Caroline Kazmer Candidate Introduction
overview: Caroline Kazmer reflected on the evolution of Medford's political landscape and endorsed a new generation of candidates for local office.

items.title: Reflections on Medford's History
items.summary: Caroline Kazmer discussed her 30-year history in the city and compared Medford's development to that of neighboring Somerville.

items.title: Support for Municipal Candidates
items.summary: Kazmer advocated for a shift away from traditional political structures and expressed support for candidates Anna Callahan and Aaron.
